sloka: त्वयि प्रव्रजिते वीर गुरोश्च वचने स्थिते।रक्षसा ऽपहृता भार्या प्राणैः प्रियतरा तव ।। ६.८३.४१ ।।
transliteration: tvayi pravrajite vīra gurośca vacane sthite।rakṣasā 'pahṛtā bhāryā prāṇaiḥ priyatarā tava ।। 6.83.41 ।।

translations.english: "O heroic Rama! You have been faithful to the promise to your father and left home following dharma (giving up wealth), and your dear wife who is your life has been abducted by Rakshasa."
